si.t: The location where a new archive folder will be created to store metadata as well as model inputs and outputs

An optional field with a text file that contains login credentials for the NASA Earthdata website (required for gathering NLDAS data); on the first line, there should be a username, and on the second line, there should be a password
The path to a folder that contains raw historic weather data (with separate folders for each source); for the model run, these files will be copied and stored in the "data\shared\raw" folder

An optional field containing the path to a folder that contains completed manual review sheets (with separate folders for each watershed); for the model run, these spreadsheets' manual review edits will be integrated into the newly generated sheets
This is an optional field that identifies another folder where archived files in the "HYDROLOGY_OUTPUT_LOCATION" directory will be copied to

This is an optional field that requires a folder path; "LSPC_Workflow_Tracker.csv" will either be generated or updated by the scripts here, and the file will contain metadata from multiple workflow runs (after each run, this CSV file will be updated automatically)
Either "CATCHMENT", "HUC12", or "AUTO"; this affects how LSPC streamflow data is wrapped up before modeling a watershed in DWRAT
